verdict.rationale: Circle documents two narrow forms of autonomous execution. CCTP can trigger automated onchain actions after assets arrive at the destination chain, and Agent Wallets let an AI agent transact autonomously within spending policies you define. However, there is no documented general facility for configuring and running background automations. missing for 10: a general automation builder or scheduler, recurring or scheduled jobs, background run management and monitoring, depth beyond one-line mentions, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Trigger automated actions on the destination blockchain after assets arrive
Agent Wallets let your AI agent hold funds and transact onchain autonomously, within spending policies you define.
